subject: Ecosystem inventory and co-sell ramp
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudbridge.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ecosystem inventory & co-sell ramp

Hi Mateo / Ben / Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week — excited about the potential to co-sell Redwood with CloudBridge across GCP Marketplace and select AWS private offers. To kick things off, can we do two practical things this week: 

1) Share an inventory of the Redwood SKUs/entitlements you want to include in the initial bundle (names, metering type, public pricing vs. private offer guidance).
2) Agree an owner-level mapping so CloudBridge can claim co-sell credits and route leads correctly (HubSpot company ID + any reseller/reference IDs).

We’ve attached a one-pager on how we’ve bundled inference runtimes with partner tooling (partner_product_sheet.pdf). Proposed quick win: a 60-minute preflight workshop (tech + GTM) next Tue or Wed where we validate entitlement mappings and coordinate a mutual action plan.

Questions: 
- Do you have a standard meter mapping doc for embeddings vs. generation?
- Any constraints on NDA/contract redlines for co-sell revenue recognition?

If helpful I can propose times — Tim Osterman (cc) will own the technical intake on our side.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge AI
alicia@cloudbridge.ai

Attachment: partner_product_sheet.pdf (1 page)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ecosystem inventory & co-sell ramp

Alicia — thanks, this looks like a solid starting point. Agree on a short preflight workshop. Proposed approach from Redwood: 

- Pre-work (this week): Ben + Soojin to export SKU list + meter types and drop into the shared spreadsheet (Drive link below). Mateo to confirm HubSpot company ID mapping.
- Workshop (60m): Technical entitlement mapping (KV cache, inference SKU, embeddings SKU), co-sell lead routing, and a timeline for a joint marketplace listing (GCP first, then AWS private offer).
- Post-workshop (1 week): Draft mutual action plan (MAP) and sign-off on lead routing + marketplace listing owner.

Owners: 
- SKU export / metering: Ben Carter (ben_carter)
- Technical entitlement validation: Soojin Lee (soojin_lee)
- Commercial routing + HubSpot mapping: Mateo Alvarez (mateo_alvarez)

Availability: Tue 2026-11-10 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 2026-11-11 08:00-09:00 PT.

Drive (prelim): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodPartnerInventory
HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Will attach the exported SKU sheet after Ben drops the list.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudbridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ecosystem inventory & co-sell ramp

Looping in quick notes — I exported the SKU list and uploaded to the Drive folder (redwood_sku_export_v2.csv). Highlights / asks: 
- We currently have three meter types that are relevant: tokens (generation), vector-embedding units, and reserved-hours (dedicated). The mapping to CloudBridge product lines needs to be explicit so their meter can credit co-sell correctly.
- Pricing: public on API docs, but we’ll need a private-offer price band for the early bundle. Who will own the private-offer ticket creation on GCP?

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

Subject: Draft mutual action plan for Redwood x CloudBridge
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Tim Osterman <tim.osterman@cloudforge.com>

Team — attaching a draft MAP (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) that lays out the timeline, owners, and milestone QA for both listing and co-sell enablement. A few callouts: 

- We recommend launching the GCP listing as a private offer first so we can validate lead routing and revenue attribution before syndicating to public catalog.
- We’ve included a suggested SLA/response timeline for lead handoffs (24 business hours for first contact).
- DocuSign link below — if the MAP looks good we can route to legal for signature and then spin up the private-offer ticket: 
https://www.docusign.com/CL-234234

Quick ask: Can Redwood confirm who will create the private-offer ticket on GCP (partner console vs. CloudBridge partner ops)? Also confirm if Redwood needs any additional due-diligence evidence for the listing (SOC2 artifact, metering test account, contact for marketplace telemetry).

Looking forward to the workshop tomorrow at 10:00 PT.

Best,
Alicia

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (3 sheets)
